General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This Suzuki OEM part is 1 of the 3 panels that make up the Targa bar.
This is the center section that goes directly over your head when sitting in the car.
Center section will need to be tapped to acommodate headache bars from targa to windshield frame.
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Targa Bar Center Section
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
